_comment: Rivals Report sources. Same format as config/sources.json. Dot Esports, Sheep Esports and Liquipedia block feed readers, so they come in through Google News site: searches. X can't be read without a paid API; the official accounts' news reaches Steam, the official site and these outlets. Reddit is leads only (never BREAKING alone).

sources.name: Steam: Marvel Rivals (official news + patch notes)
Google News: Rivals esports
sources.query: "Marvel Rivals" esports OR Ignite OR "Marvel Rivals Championship" OR MRC

sources.name: Google News: Rivals patches
sources.query: "Marvel Rivals" patch OR balance OR season OR "new hero" OR hotfix

sources.name: Google News: Rivals rosters
sources.query: "Marvel Rivals" roster OR signs OR transfer OR benched OR "parts ways"

sources.name: Google News: Sheep/Dot/Liquipedia
sources.query: "Marvel Rivals" site:sheepesports.com OR site:dotesports.com OR site:liquipedia.net
